newsitem.title: GERMANY: Grain share in German mixed feed 33 pct in 1995/96.
newsitem.headline: Grain share in German mixed feed 33 pct in 1995/96.

text.p: The grain inclusion rate in German compound feed in the 1995/96 (July/June) season rose by four percent over the previous season to 33 percent, official figures from the farm ministry showed on Monday.
This was the highest share since the 1976/77 season.
In volume terms, grain usage in feed rose by 15 percent to 6.25 million tonnes, the ministry said, citing high world market prices for competing feedstuffs.
Out of the total, western Germany's grain usage rose to 4.85 million tonnes (from 4.24 million a year earlier) and the grain share in mixed feed rose to 31 percent (27).
In eastern Germany, the corresponding figures for grain usage were 1.40 million tonnes (1.20 million) and the grain share 42 percent (37).

German compound feed production in the 95/96 season rose by 0.6 percent to 19.06 million tonnes, of which eastern Germany accounted for 3.31 million tonnes (3.24 million 94/95) and western Germany for 15.75 million (15.71).
Of the 19.1 million total, 7.90 million were cattle feed, 6.05 million pigfeed and 4.05 million poultry feed and the remainder horse feed and pet food.
